assets.prompt: Wide elevated view of two complete islands separated by an open sunny turquoise strait. Left: whitewashed stone harbor town, stone loom shed, fishing dock and sailing fishing boats. Rocky and grassy foreground, sunlit middle-ground islands, distant hazy horizon. Open water center for an animated trade boat. No people.
